bib.venue: NeurIPS 2025 (39th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems)

question: Can the core capabilities of LLMs (scalability, in-context learning, instruction following) be achieved by a masked diffusion model trained from scratch, rather than an autoregressive one?
hypothesis: Those capabilities stem from generative modeling principles (maximum likelihood, Transformers, scale), not from the autoregressive factorisation specifically.
contributions: LLaDA scales to a 10^23 FLOPs compute budget with results comparable to ARM baselines trained on the same data across six tasks
LLaDA 8B Base surpasses LLaMA2 7B on nearly all of 15 zero/few-shot tasks and is on par with LLaMA3 8B
LLaDA improves instruction following after SFT (multi-turn dialogue case studies)
LLaDA breaks the reversal curse, outperforming GPT-4o on reversal poem completion

method.summary: A Transformer without causal mask is trained as a mask predictor: each token is masked independently at ratio t~U[0,1] and the model predicts masked tokens with a 1/t-weighted cross-entropy that upper-bounds negative log-likelihood. 8B model pre-trained from scratch on 2.3T tokens, SFT on 4.5M pairs; sampling runs a reverse diffusion from fully masked with low-confidence remasking.
method.task: masked diffusion language modeling (pre-training + SFT) and benchmark evaluation

datasets.name: Pre-training corpus (in-house)
datasets.source: public web data, books, academic papers, social media, encyclopedias, math, code; approx 11% Chinese, 61% English, 28% code; not released
datasets.preprocessing: PDF text extraction, deduplication, harmful content filtering, fine-tuned BERT quality annotator to select higher-quality samples; documents concatenated and cut to fixed length 4096; 1% of data given random length uniform in [1,4096]

datasets.name: SFT corpus (in-house)
datasets.source: code, math, instruction following; synthetic generated by methods like Xu et al. and Wei et al.
datasets.preprocessing: |EOS| appended to shorter pairs in a mini-batch to equal length, treated as response tokens (masked, in loss), removed at sampling; n-turn dialogues split into n single-turn pairs and one sampled

datasets.name: Benchmarks
datasets.source: MMLU, BBH, ARC-C, Hellaswag, TruthfulQA, WinoGrande, PIQA, GSM8K, Math, GPQA, HumanEval, HumanEval-FIM, MBPP, CMMLU, C-Eval, MMLU-Pro

datasets.name: Poem completion (Chinese)
datasets.split: zero-shot, forward (next line) and reversal (previous line)
datasets.source: constructed by authors, following Allen-Zhu and Li

datasets.name: iGSM
datasets.preprocessing: '#### answer' appended; system prompt plus four-shot pairs, arithmetic mod 5

models.name: LLaDA 8B (Base, Instruct)
models.architecture: Transformer mask predictor, no causal mask, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, RoPE, vanilla multi-head attention (32 KV heads)

models.name: ARM baseline 1B
models.architecture: same as LLaDA 1B with causal mask

other.note: used instead of an 8B ARM for compute reasons

models.name: LLaMA2 7B, Qwen2 7B, Qwen2.5 7B, Mistral 7B, Gemma2 9B, DeepSeek 7B, GPT-4o, Qwen2.5-7B Instruct

other.note: LLaMA2 and LLaMA3 re-evaluated by authors; Qwen/Mistral/Gemma/DeepSeek numbers copied from their reports

training.objective: Masked diffusion cross-entropy on masked tokens weighted 1/t, t~U[0,1] (Eq 3); SFT masks only response tokens (Eq 5)
training.lr: 8B pre-train: 4e-4 peak, 1e-4 after 1.2T tokens, 1e-5 final; SFT 2.5e-5 to 2.5e-6; 7B ARM 4.2e-4
training.lr_schedule: Warmup-Stable-Decay. Pre-train: 4e-4 held to 1.2T tokens, 1e-4 for next 0.8T, linear 1e-4 to 1e-5 over last 0.3T. SFT: constant, linear to 2.5e-6 over final 10% of iterations
training.warmup: linear 0 to max over first 2000 iterations (pre-train); first 50 iterations (SFT)
training.batch_size: pre-train 1280 (local 4 per GPU); SFT global 256 (local 2 per GPU); 7B ARM 4224
training.seeds: 8B pre-train and SFT each executed once, no hyperparameter tuning

other.scaling_flops: 6ND with N non-embedding params, D tokens
other.lr_note: LR reduced once mid-run for stability
other.1B_runs: max lr 4e-4, batch 1280 for 1B ARM and both LLaDA sizes

inference.decoding: Pure diffusion reverse process from fully masked response, low-confidence remasking, uniform timesteps, greedy token prediction; |EOS| tokens after first discarded
inference.max_tokens: generation length is a hyperparameter: Base 1024 (steps 1024); Instruct answer length 3 (MMLU, HellaSwag), 64 (GPQA), 256 (MBPP, MMLU-Pro), 512 (HumanEval, GSM8K, Math, ARC-C), steps equal length
inference.samples: Likelihood tasks: 128 Monte Carlo samples (1 for MMLU, CMMLU, C-Eval); generation tasks single run
inference.prompting: Shots per Tables 1 and 2 (e.g. MMLU 5, GSM8K 4, BBH 3, 0-shot ARC-C/HellaSwag/HumanEval); lm-evaluation-harness for Base, internal library for Instruct and HumanEval-FIM

parameters.cfg_scale: searched in {0.5,1,1.5,2} per task, best reported, only in ablation Table 6
parameters.eos_confidence: set to zero for Instruct on HumanEval, MBPP, GSM8K, Math, GPQA
parameters.likelihood_estimator: Eq 6, l uniform in {1..L}, l tokens masked without replacement

other.throughput_setup: single A100-80GB, batch 1, bf16, LLaDA output length 256, steps 32/64/128/256

metrics.name: Accuracy / exact match
metrics.definition: Likelihood ranking of candidates for MMLU, CMMLU, C-Eval, ARC-C, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, WinoGrande, PIQA, GPQA (Base); conditional generation with exact match or equivalent for the rest

eval.protocol: Single run, no seeds or significance tests; LLaMA2/3 re-evaluated under same protocol, others copied from reports

prompts.text: You're an expert at solving elementary math problems involving addition, subtraction, and multiplication. You solve all the problems in a uniform format. All calculations are done modulo 5. [...] please end with '#### x.' where x is your final answer, an integer between 0 and 4.

limits: Generation length is a user-specified hyperparameter (authors say adaptive length would be better)
Matched LLaDA vs ARM comparisons stay below 10^23 FLOPs; the ARM baseline was not scaled to 8B (7B with different FFN/KV heads used)
No specialized attention, position embeddings or KV cache; sampling algorithms preliminary
No RL alignment, so Instruct trails LLaMA3 8B Instruct; MMLU dropped after SFT, attributed to SFT data quality
Training data closed, so strengths/weaknesses vs LLaMA3 attributed to data differences, not isolated
Single run each, no seeds or error bars
Autoregressive sampling for Instruct performs very badly (GSM8K 0); pure diffusion needs |EOS| confidence zeroed
Models are the LLaDA 8B Base/Instruct of early 2025; later work has superseded them
